content: Therefore, directly using the limited amount of actual news articles for end-to-end system training becomes problematic. In our initial experiments the generation model learns to “hallucinate” facts, as easily occurs when the target text is too loosely related to the conditioning input. In order to ensure that the generation model is able to learn to generate accurate descriptions from game statistics, we clean the news corpus by manually aligning corresponding text spans with game events detailed in the statistics.
